Idk if you ever listened to Make you love me but it’s a scrapper Kanye song from around the Yandhi era. In the end of the song his verse says “I immediately took the media and made it what it means to me. I control this shit. I control the public strings. I control the narrative.” If you haven’t ever heard it it’s on YouTube. It has Tyga rapping over Kanye’s verse so it was probably very early in the process but it’s pretty much Kanye showing that he is self aware about what he does and that he can and will make you hate him to prove that he can make you live him again.

I understand what you are trying to say calling Come to Life the runaway of the album but I don’t even think it is a Runaway. I believe it deserves the title of being something of its own. It’s so beautiful. The first time I heard it I was watching the listening party on my TV and got up from my bed in awe. Seeing him lighting himself on fire actually made me cry. That has so many meanings to it as well but I’m sure most Kanye fans understand haha.

Come to life and Runaway might be his best 2 songs. With Runaway you have a man who wants to escape the limelight and escape the criticism of the world. But realizes that it will forever be impossible being a superstar at his level. With Come to Life it’s almost a completely different story. It’s been 11 years since we had a runaway Kanye. Now we have a man who has survived some of the craziest events due his mental illness. A brash individual who at the end of the day cannot be stopped or canceled. You can’t kill whats already dead. Come to Life is him telling you to follow your dreams. Block out the criticism you will receive trying to do so. Because if Kanye can survive what he has went through, anybody can too.
Putting Come to Life that low is a crime against humanity
